official_sources.finding: Global signout ends existing sessions/refresh tokens; issued access JWTs retain expiration. No shared PostgreSQL transaction interface documented.
session_id corresponds to auth.sessions; live checks close sensitive-action logout gaps. New login is different from restored competence.
Owner/Admin and Developer can run SQL; access to project is not Prumo organizational authorization.
Prefer INVOKER, fixed search_path, revoke PUBLIC execute; do not expose privileged functions.
Reviewed public HTML index after markdown fetch was blocked/unsupported. No claim that every historical release was exhaustively audited.

Managed-schema restrictions include DDL and migration-table DML; this is not a blanket ban of every auth.sessions DML. It also does not by itself establish support for the I86 locking/deletion algorithm.
2026 rollout changes public-table default grants; existing grants remain. Private-schema safety still requires explicit ACL verification.
Scoped PATs announced 2026-10-06; evaluate actual grants and custody rather than assuming all tokens are unscoped. No token is created or used here.
